controls.rule: No absolute, performance or urgency claim ('guaranteed', 'unhackable', '100%', 'fully compliant', 'certified', 'proven', 'best', 'limited time', ...) in ad copy unless a substantiation entry names a file in this repository that proves it.

No audience or targeting built on a sensitive personal trait (health or medical condition, disability, pregnancy, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, political views, union membership, immigration status, criminal record, debt or financial hardship). An industry is not a trait.

No remarketing, customer-list upload or conversion pixel while legal/privacy.html says ClearGlass deploys no advertising cookies or third-party tracking pixels. The policy changes first, with counsel; then a dated legal review is required at approval.
A landing page links the privacy policy, declares its language, gives every image a text alternative and every visible form field a label.
For each platform a package carries ads for: the date the owner read that platform's current ad policies, and its advertiser-verification state ('verified' or 'not_required').
Every login to an ad account the campaign spends through uses multi-factor authentication.

A package that sends email records the recipient list's consent basis ('express' or 'implied'); every message still passes python -m bots.outreach_preflight (sender identification, mailing address, unsubscribe).
A dated review by qualified counsel when copy names compliance, privacy law, legal matters, insurance, regulators, OSINT or cross-border matters, or when targeting tracks visitors.
No personal information reaches an analytics provider, and no funnel event fires until the owner chooses a provider.
